items.description: PACIFIC MISSILE RANGE FACILITY, KEKAHA, HAWAII – Pacific Missile Range Facility is currently under Tropical Cyclone Conditions of Readiness One Emergency, or TCCOR 1E, due to severe weather conditions associated with Hurricane Lowell.  Due to potentially hazardous conditions, all personnel and base residents are directed to shelter in place and remain indoors until TCCOR All Clear is announced.

items.title: PMRF sets TCCOR 1 in response to severe weather forecast from Hurricane Lowell
items.description: PACIFIC MISSILE RANGE FACILITY, KEKAHA, Hawaii - Pacific Missile Range Facility (PMRF) has set Tropical Cyclone Condition of Readiness (TCCOR) One indicating that destructive winds of 50 knots or greater are possible within 12 hours. PMRF continues to monitor Hurricane Lowell and has secured the installation in preparation for severe weather.
